why: True for lights, shadowGenerator and receiveShadows, but a mesh with a new material family added after registerScene has its group builder run at runtime, so builders do not run only once at registerScene.
The link, scene.lights and caster conditions hold, but setShadowTaskCasterMeshes(sg, []) with no casters still makes the shadow task render the generator.
registerScene adds no shadow task even with a linked generator and casters, and registerSceneWithShadowSupport puts exactly one "shadow" task first.
Removal does retire the mesh, but when a cloneTransformNode clone still shares the geometry, a re-add before teardown does not lose its buffers, which stay alive.
A plain write on one light is also uploaded when another light is added or another light's setLightIntensity runs, because the whole UBO is refilled, so its own version is not the only trigger.
If child.parent = p was assigned first, a later setParent(child, p) sees no link change and leaves p.children empty, so setParent does not always move it into p.children.
Depth runs from the light's world position, so under a parent a caster ahead of the world position is inside the range even though light.position stays [0,0,0].
After one setFog, a plain scene.fog = newObject is written, and an in-place edit is written as soon as the camera moves, so neither "writes no fog" nor "not rewritten" holds in general.
addToScene recursively adds and parents children, lists no TransformNode, and pushing to children alone leaves parent null.
Removal recurses through children, sets parent to null on each removed node and the entity, and leaves the children arrays unchanged.
True for the shape factories probed, but createLines/createLineSystem take a name option and come with a line material, so not every mesh factory takes no name or gives a null material.
An id-less mesh listed in a non-empty includedOnlyMeshes is lit even when includedOnlyMeshIds is non-empty, because the object set takes over.
lightAffectsMesh checks the object sets first with exclusion subtracting, and lets includedOnlyMeshIds beat excludedMeshIds, as stated.
Each added camera replaces scene.camera, and removing the active one sets it to null with no fallback while removing another leaves it.
onBeforeRender unshifts, so callbacks run newest first, and each gets fixedDeltaMs only when it is above 0.
The fit uses only boundMin/boundMax under worldMatrix, ignores thin-instance matrices, and widened bounds bring far instances in.
The arrays are kept and capacity is count, but after setThinInstances with count 0, addThinInstance doubles 0 to 0 and throws a RangeError instead of moving to a new array.
A direct write to instance 0 followed by setThinInstanceMatrix(mesh, 1, m) is not uploaded, because the setter dirties only its own slot, so "another thin-instance setter" does not flush it.
removeThinInstance copies the last matrix into the gap, drops the count, and leaves the colors array untouched.
light.shadowGenerator is cleared as stated, but the probe shows no disposal, and the generator's task state is only disposed at a later rebuild or disposeScene, with its UBO left alive.
Only the first MAX_LIGHTS lights are uploaded or selected, silently, and setMaxLights(20) lets 17 through, even after the UBO already exists.
A hemispheric color write is also uploaded after direction.set or when another light is added, not only after _bumpLightVersion or setLightIntensity.
The uploaded position and direction come from the world matrix, follow later parent moves, and the direction is renormalized under parent scale.
setMeshVisible writes the value through every descendant, so showing a parent re-shows children that were hidden on their own.
rotation writes update rotationQuaternion and the matrix, and a quaternion set changes what rotation reads.
worldMatrix is current on read after transform or parent writes, and the versions of children and grandchildren are bumped at once when an ancestor moves.
Disabling skips the map render and uploads darkness 1 for PCF, ESM, spot and CSM, and re-enabling restores the configured darkness, which defaults to 0.
Spot PCF uses mapSize 512, near 1 and far from light.range read once at creation (10000 if MAX_VALUE), and the directional types use 1024; near 1 was confirmed in the code but not by the probe.
Mesh, node and light children are cloned with "_clone" names, but cloneTransformNode throws a TypeError on a node that has a camera child, so it does not deep-clone every child.

setThinInstanceDrawCount also throws after a first sync once any later matrix write leaves the pool unsynced, and it does not throw for an unchanged count, so "until a first GPU sync" is wrong both ways.
disposeScene empties the lists, sets camera to null, disposes at once the meshes it held last, and leaves meshes another scene holds alive.
A null-material mesh is listed but joins no group, and a later material assignment puts it in _materialSwapQueue.
setThinInstanceColor throws a TypeError until colors exist, and enableThinInstanceGpuCulling throws on a mesh with no thinInstances.
Under a singular parent, the local position becomes the child's old world position (also when it had an earlier parent), and rotation and scale are left as they were.
numCascades above 4 is clamped to 4 without error, smaller values are kept, and the default is 4.
